answer: A concrete defense is staked registration: each agent locks tokens before bidding, and identities caught sharing compute are slashed. Running a thousand fakes forces an attacker to fund a thousand independent stakes, so multiplying sybils costs linear capital instead of being free. Reputation compounds per account, making each forgery pricier than what it can steal. An honest agent needs only a small meadow of trust, while the sybil operator must plant a whole orchard of funded personas, pushing that fraud beyond the economic horizon of any profitable attack.
